agenticWorkflows.head: Agentic workflows
agenticWorkflows.lead: I plan each project as a map of tasks, and AI agents build it ticket by ticket. The maps below are the real ones.

lessons.all: Every workflow, in the developer view

answerFirst.paid: Build tickets were filed the night before the final design (#208). A newsletter provider was swapped after it was already wired in (#242 → #299).

blockedTicket.paid: Otherwise an agent could start from a plan that changed an hour ago. The pick command checks GitHub first and refuses.
blockedTicket.rule: A blocked ticket can't be picked.

hostDecision.paid: A hosting switch slipped in under a lint ticket and was reverted two days later (#377, #378).
hostDecision.rule: Changing host is its own decision.

realDeploy.paid: Four bugs only showed up once the site was deployed (#382, #387, #388, #395).
realDeploy.rule: Test deploy work on a real deploy.

unknownsFirst.paid: Hosting was picked on paper, then changed five times (#186, #244, #302, #377).

lessons.line: Each one cost a real project time. The numbers are the tickets where it happened.
